description: Start (re)authorizing this server with ANAF when the grant is dead or about to end. Returns authorizeUrl for the CERTIFICATE HOLDER to open in a browser with the qualified digital certificate; you cannot do that step. Then call complete_authorization with the address the browser lands on, within 60 seconds of it landing. Starting again replaces an earlier begun authorization.

redirect_uri.description: One of the redirect URIs registered in app.json. Empty means the first one.

name: begin_authorization
title: Begin ANAF authorization
